paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between average lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for three different models: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis represents AL, displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 10.0, with tick labels spaced at increments of 0.5. The y-axis represents BLEU scores, ranging from 18.0 to 28.5, with tick marks at intervals of 2.0. The first line, designated Consistency-CE, is represented by a dashed blue line with circular markers at data points such as (0.0, 26.5), (2.5, 27.5), (5.0, 28.0), (7.5, 27.8), and (10.0, 28.2). The second line, Inconsistency-CE, is depicted as a solid purple line with square markers at data points like (0.0, 22.0), (2.5, 25.0), (5.0, 26.5), (7.5, 27.0), and (10.0, 27.5). Finally, the third line, Consistency-Bi, is shown as a solid red line with star markers at locations like (0.0, 20.5), (2.5, 23.0), (5.0, 24.5), (7.5, 25.5), and (10.0, 26.0).
